tagline: Genie Ontology is now generally available.
what_it_does: Genie Ontology is now generally available. Genie Ontology is the context layer that gives Genie One, Genie Code, and other AI agents a business aware map of your organization. It combines modeled knowledge that you define in Unity Catalog semantics with learned knowledge that Genie extracts from your assets and usage.
why_it_matters: This ensures that both human users and AI tools interpret your data consistently under a single governance model.
